description.value: Rail and River Bistro (also branded as the Rail and River Steak & Seafood House) is a riverside full-service restaurant in historic Fort Langley, serving AAA premium cuts alongside West Coast seafood including salmon, prawns, and scallops, complemented by BC wines and craft cocktails. The restaurant is part of the Fairhaven Group and can seat up to 60 guests for private events on-site. It runs a monthly 'Voyager Club' themed five-course dinner series, adding a notable special-event dimension to the regular brunch, lunch, and dinner offerings.
